posts.name: ZooWork
posts.tagline: The AI agent delivery platform for FDEs and domain experts
posts.description: ZooWork lets you build, deploy, and deliver AI agents to teams or clients — experts start in the Builder UI, developers ship with the Managed Agent API. Turn your expertise into AI solutions built for real business operations.

posts.name: miso.com
posts.tagline: Book flights and hotels through iMessage
posts.description: Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

posts.name: Prefer
posts.tagline: The execution layer for AEO
posts.description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

posts.name: Muse Gadgets
posts.tagline: Meta's open-source kit for building your own AI gadgets
posts.description: Muse Gadgets is Meta's open-source hardware toolkit for bringing Muse into the physical world. Connect an ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or Linux device to displays, microphones, speakers, buttons, sensors, and more, then let Muse interact through the hardware you build. Make a pocket AI companion, e-ink briefing display, smart-home controller, TV interface, or something entirely your own. SDKs and firmware are open source under Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Kindle 2026
posts.tagline: A smaller, faster Kindle with a flush-front display
posts.description: Kindle 2026 is Amazon’s redesigned 6-inch e-reader, now smaller and lighter with 30% faster book opening and a flush-front display. It also comes in a new 32GB aluminum version for the first time.

posts.name: SCMD
posts.tagline: Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory.
posts.description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

posts.name: Cubicle
posts.tagline: A live office for your AI agents, read-only by design
posts.description: Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Paperclip agents work in a live office: they sit down and type, raise a hand or line up at your desk when they need you, and go to the lounge when done. KPI board for your tasks, Telegram alerts with the agent's questions, phone view, pixel or HD themes, real faces, your logo. One command (npx), zero dependencies, MIT. Read-only by design: it only watches; the one optional write is your own Telegram reply, posted as a comment.

posts.name: FoundrRadio
posts.tagline: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air
posts.description: FoundrRadio is an internet radio platform where founders could own their own radio stations and go on air. Visitors could listen to their favourite founders, their talks or music they love. An opportunity to own a small corner on the internet. An attempt to combine nostalgia and community.

posts.name: Notchware
posts.tagline: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch
posts.description: That notch at the top of your MacBook does nothing. Notchware turns it into a live island: Now Playing with artwork and playback controls, plus battery, volume, brightness, Focus, and Wi-Fi status right where you look. Notchware Pro ($3.99 one-time) adds Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor alerts, so you know the moment an agent needs approval or finishes, without watching the terminal. Native SwiftUI. No account, no analytics, no cloud. macOS 14.6+.

posts.name: eu/jev
posts.tagline: The first Jev-like model hosted in the EU
posts.description: If you want to try System One models like Jev for work, but can't because of GDPR and data sovereignty issues, eu/jev is for you; it's the first System One model hosted in the EU, running on our Hetzner GPUs in Germany. It's fully GDPR compliant and we don't save any prompts/answers. You can call it exactly the way you'd call Jev, at the exact same pricing as Jev (which means free output tokens!). Built on Winnow, the #1 open-source System One model on JevBench.

posts.name: MacCam
posts.tagline: The camera app Apple never shipped for the Mac
posts.description: MacCam is a free, native camera app for macOS. Take photos and videos with your Mac's camera, iPhone or any webcam - straight into Apple Photos. Classic Photo Booth effects plus Portrait, Studio Light and Edge Light built in. Coming to Pro: a teleprompter, eye contact and knock to shoot - free for life for the first 100,000.

posts.name: FeelMyMac
posts.tagline: Lets you feel different textures through your Mac’s trackpad
posts.description: FeelMyMac brings haptic textures to cursor movement and scrolling on Mac trackpads. Instead of feeling feedback only when you click, you can actually feel simulated surfaces as you move your cursor, with different materials and textures to choose from. You can enable haptics separately for cursor customize intensity, and add optional sound effects. FeelMyMac also includes keyboard sounds for an extra layer of feedback. How it works? Easy it's Taptic Engine just like an iPhone would!

posts.name: una mano
posts.tagline: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb
posts.description: una mano moves a familiar QWERTY keyboard left, centre, or right when a hand is busy. Use the Position control or swipe to move it. Plus adds optional Motion Switch. Core typing works without Full Access. New installs get 14 days of Plus; no plan is selected.

posts.name: Deskcord.chat
posts.tagline: A widget to chat with customers from your Discord server
posts.description: Turn Discord into your support desk and chat with your customers. Embed our chat widget in 5 minutes and let your customers reach out to you directly to your server. Every conversation in the widget becomes a Discord thread. Unlimited seats, unlimited domains. Deskcord is built for solo founders and small teams. Skip the bloated and expensive tools and get closer to your customers from the comfort of your Discord server. Deskcord is an alternative to the giants like Intercom, Crisp or Zendesk.

posts.name: Agent Activity
posts.tagline: See what your AI agents do behind
posts.description: See what your AI coding agents are doing behind the scene: every session, build, test run and screenshot, live and per agent. Reads what Claude Code and Xcode leave on disk, all on your Mac — usage and crash data only after you say yes. macOS 26 + Xcode 27.

posts.name: WattMate
posts.tagline: Which app is draining your Mac, in watts and minutes saved
posts.description: WattMate sits in the Mac menu bar and shows which app is draining the battery right now, in watts, and how many minutes you get back if you quit it. 2 minutes after you quit, it measures again and prints what really changed. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

posts.name: Crowny!
posts.tagline: Claude Code, Codex, music, your day & 20+ apps in your notch
posts.description: Crowny is the best dynamic notch app for MacBook: manag Ai Agents, music, timers, your calendar, reminders, clipboard, files, games and water reminders live in the notch, one glance up. And when Claude Code, Codex or Grok needs you, it taps you right there.$5 for first few !

posts.name: bmux
posts.tagline: Browser multiplexer for the agentic era
posts.description: A free, open-source browser with split panes, named sessions, and separate profiles in one window. Browse with keyboard shortcuts while agents work in background sessions through the CLI. Attach whenever you want to see their work.

posts.name: Kilo
posts.tagline: Your agentic fitness coach in iMessage
posts.description: Kilo builds your training program, texts you your workouts, and uses your logs and check-ins to recommend what comes next. Coaching in iMessage, with workout tracking built in. Join the free private beta.

posts.name: bawkterm
posts.tagline: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH
posts.description: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH and Remote Desktop, on Windows and Linux. - GitHub - juddisjudd/bawkterm: A desktop client for SSH, SFTP, Docker over SSH and Remote Desktop, on Windows and Linux.

posts.name: OTPfill
posts.tagline: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac
posts.description: OTPfill is a Mac menu-bar app. When a site emails you a verification code, it appears under the code field. Click Fill.

posts.name: Sapien
posts.tagline: AI market research with synthetic populations
posts.description: Use simulated audiences to compare product concepts, marketing, prices and market strategies. Sapien builds the audience, runs the study and delivers interactive findings with segment comparisons. Bring a business question, explore likely responses and ask follow-up questions with the same population.

posts.name: Yubi
posts.tagline: Talk to your Mac and let Yubi do the typing
posts.description: Yubi is a 6 MB Mac app. Hold the right Option key, talk, and your words land at the cursor. Hold right Command when you need help on screen. Your voice never leaves this Mac. Free to talk. Email sign in. No card for Free.

posts.name: Singularity
posts.tagline: Run AI coding agents in parallel, one ticket at a time
posts.description: Chatting with AI coding agents burns context and time. Singularity replaces the chat with atomic tickets: one scope, one isolated Git worktree, minimal context. Run agents in parallel across repos, review the diff, merge. Free, local-first, bring your own key.

posts.name: Thanor AI
posts.tagline: Make your AI-built sites look expensive and not like slop
posts.description: Everything built with AI looks built with AI. Thanor fixes the input. Paste a full brief into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable or Bolt: palette, type scale, motion, structure section by section. New: an MCP server that pulls any prompt into your editor. Soon: a cloning tool that turns a site you admire into a design of your own. New prompts and components every week, and a community forming around it. For people who build and sell sites, designers starting out, SaaS devs and founders.

posts.name: Snail Walk
posts.tagline: Keep walking or Bob (the snail) is gonna get ya! 🐌
posts.description: Snail Walk is a walking fitness game where a giant snail follows you and only way to progress in the game is to walk in real life. Steps are synced using Apple Health / Health Connect and players have already walked 10M+ steps so far.

posts.name: Botscope
posts.tagline: See every bot and AI agent. Then decide who gets in.
posts.description: Botscope classifies every request as human, verified crawler, scraper, or AI agent — with the decision and the reason. See which models crawl you, which pages they cite, and which send people back. Observe first: nothing is blocked until you say so. Then allow, challenge, or block per agent. Verified search bots stay safe; robots.txt stays in sync. Start with a script tag. Enforce via WordPress, PHP agent, Cloudflare Worker, or DNS. Same panel. Free to 100,000 events a month, no card.

posts.name: BeanRitual
posts.tagline: AI assistant that helps you dial in your best espresso shot
posts.description: Every bag of coffee needs its own settings, and a month later you've forgotten them. BeanRitual remembers. Photograph the bag and the app reads the label. Note each espresso: dose, grind, time, yield, and good or not yet. Star the one that worked, and it's waiting on that bag's page next time. Free, no account. In beta on iPhone: join at coffee.saylib.com and I'll send you an invitation.

posts.name: WikiFix for Confluence
posts.tagline: Find and fix issues in your knowledge base
posts.description: WikiFix monitors your KB for issues like contradicting pages, duplicates and orphans, and fixes them in one click once you approve, so your team can trust what it reads or hears from AI.

posts.name: Launchy Widget
posts.tagline: Add quick, custom widgets to your Android home screen
posts.description: Launchy Widget is a lightweight, customizable Android home screen widget designed to streamline your phone setup. It works seamlessly with any Android launcher, giving you instant access to your favorite apps, direct speed-dials, web browser bookmarks, and app shortcuts. Organize your home screen, save screen space, and launch everything you need with a single tap.

posts.name: Reassign
posts.tagline: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers
posts.description: Let the shape of your day tell the story. Reassign is a 24-hour circular planner for busy makers. Midnight up top, noon at the bottom. Drag to block time. Reshape it when plans fall apart. It speaks AI. Brain-dump or brainstorm into the command palette and watch AI rebuild your afternoon, live. It mirrors everything. Google Calendar, Outlook, Todoist, Linear, all in two-way sync. Plus focus mode and an energy curve from your sleep. One dial. Every source. Full control.

posts.name: zinbox
posts.tagline: All your Gmail accounts. One native Mac app.
posts.description: zinbox keeps every Gmail and Google Workspace inbox signed in, side by side, with one dock badge and real macOS notifications.

posts.name: MadeToPost
posts.tagline: Create social media creatives for your app in seconds
posts.description: MadeToPost helps indie developers and app makers turn launches, updates, reviews, ratings, and milestones into polished social media creatives in just a few clicks. Add your app from the App Store, choose what you want to share, customize the design, and export it as a static image or animation. No design tools. No starting from scratch. Just a faster way to turn what you ship into content.

posts.name: appsonbid.com
posts.tagline: Zero-commission marketplace to buy & sell apps
posts.description: Appsonbid.com is a zero-commission marketplace to buy and sell apps / micro-SaaS. We use a "Blind Teaser" architecture to hide your URL from copycats, while letting buyers bid/offer freely on your verified revenue, MRR and GA4 traffic. Keep 100% of your exit.

posts.name: Growth Audit by Business Mechanics
posts.tagline: Find What's Blocking Your Business Growth in Minutes
posts.description: Get a clear score, identify revenue leaks, and a step-by-step action plan.

posts.name: Delulu
posts.tagline: How delusional is your goal? Get the math, not vibes
posts.description: Delulu stress-tests ambitious goals. Type a dream ($20K MRR in 5 months, 52 books this year, a marathon by April) and get a receipt: a 0–100 Delulu Score plus exactly what it takes, like customers a month, pages a day or weekly mileage. It's deterministic math, not AI guesses. Drag every assumption to make it less delulu, pin your 2027 goals to a board, or dare a friend. 100% free, no sign-up, no paywall.

posts.name: StudentGu
posts.tagline: Student discounts, free perks & gift cards in one place
posts.description: Free perks and gift cards for verified US college students. StudentGu helps college students find student discounts, free perks and limited-run gift cards in one place. Browse by category, verify your college email, and unlock redemption links or promo codes. Free to join; offer terms apply. Browse across software, productivity, design, food & drink, shopping, entertainment and travel. Filter by free perks, gift cards or discounts to find what interests you. Thanks for checking out StudentGu!

posts.name: GPT-6 Sol and and Luna
posts.tagline: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
posts.description: GPT-6 Sol and Luna are fast, cost-efficient AI models for professional work, coding, computer use, and long-running agents. Built with advances from GPT-6 Astra, they deliver stronger factual accuracy and clearer collaboration while API prices are 50% lower than GPT-5.6. Choose Sol for demanding tasks and Luna for high-volume, everyday AI workloads.

posts.name: Forecall
posts.tagline: Lint your MCP tool descriptions before AI agents call them
posts.description: AI agents choose and call MCP tools by reading their names, descriptions and input schemas. Vague text means the wrong tool, wrong arguments, or no call at all. Forecall scores each tool out of 100 on six items (purpose, when to use, arguments, return value, constraints, examples), finds tools that are easy to mix up, and explains every issue with a code and severity. Free on the web with no sign-up, or run npx forecall lint locally and in CI.

posts.name: FormSubmit
posts.tagline: The form backend for any website
posts.description: Point any HTML, WordPress, React, Next.js, Vue or Astro form at a FormSubmit endpoint and get submissions by email, webhooks, Slack, Discord and Google Sheets. Spam protection and file uploads included. Free plan available.

posts.name: GTA 6 Cover Art Generator by MockupTown
posts.tagline: Turn your own photos into a GTA VI style collage!
posts.description: Turn your own photos into a GTA VI style collage cover with the big VI logo. Make Grand Theft Auto cover art, wallpapers and posters free, no signup, and your images never leave your device.

posts.name: BeMyLink
posts.tagline: Your screenshots come alive with Ai
posts.description: Saved a dress, a recipe, or an idea for your home? BeMyLink helps you find it again. It automatically imports screenshots, organizes them into searchable categories, and helps you return to relevant websites. No sign-up or uploading screenshots one by one. Available on iOS and Android. Exact original-page matches aren't always possible—we're continuing to improve link accuracy.

posts.name: Imgkeep
posts.tagline: Save any image as PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, with 4 permissions
posts.description: Right-click any image to save it as PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF (animations keep moving), straight into your folder. Converted on your computer; nothing is uploaded. Only 4 permissions, no access to your pages, no tracking. Free and open source, for Chrome and Edge.

posts.name: Rival Workshop
posts.tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
posts.description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

posts.name: uLuup · Goals take time
posts.tagline: Goals you can quit and come back to
posts.description: Write what you want and uLuup turns it into a plan. Do a step when you can. A quiet week leaves a crack in your bowl, and coming back fills it with gold. Version 2 is a full rebuild: plans from one sentence, seasons that keep your past on a shelf, and a journal on every goal. No streaks to lose.

posts.name: FLUX 3 Action
posts.tagline: An open-weight AI model for predicting robot actions
posts.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS turn text into expressive speech. Create custom voices from natural-language prompts, control pacing, emotion and dialect, and generate long-form audio or two-speaker conversations.

posts.name: Reesvi
posts.tagline: Ship 30 days of content in 30 sec
posts.description: Reesvi is an AI clipping agent for creators and agencies. Paste a YouTube link, Twitch VOD, podcast, or upload your own file (up to 3 hours) — Reesvi transcribes it, finds the moments actually worth sharing, and cuts them into auto-reframed, captioned vertical clips. No scrubbing through hours of footage, with embeded editing software — just export, or schedule straight to your channels. Free to try, no card required for your first video

posts.name: Solus
posts.tagline: Learn complex topics with bite-sized courses
posts.description: Turn any topic into a focused, interactive course built around how you learn.

posts.name: MadeLaunch
posts.tagline: Launch what you built and get seen by early adopters
posts.description: MadeLaunch is a free launch platform for indie makers. Post your product, get upvotes and feedback from early adopters, and climb the daily leaderboard. Since our first launch, 219 makers have launched ~300 products, from AI tools to SaaS. What's new: a fresh design, a daily leaderboard, and a featured section to help great launches get seen.

posts.name: Sonic Refine
posts.tagline: Remove noise, breaths & silence on your PC — no uploads
posts.description: Sonic Refine is a Windows app that cleans your voice recordings and videos in one click. It removes noise, breaths (even the fake ones AI voices add) and dead air, then evens out loudness. For video, it compresses big files, converts formats, and turns 16:9 into 9:16 by following the face. AI runs on your own CPU, so nothing is uploaded: no queue, no GPU, no per-hour bills. Made for AI voice creators, podcasters and editors. Free for 2 hours a month, no account needed.

posts.name: Astro Discover
posts.tagline: Discover what makers build — from raw ideas to live launches
posts.description: Discover what makers are building — explore trending AI tools, indie SaaS, developer utilities, and startups before they trend worldwide.

posts.name: Keepp MCP server
posts.tagline: Website builder with every tool you need built in
posts.description: MCP server for Keepp: a free website and link-in-bio builder with a store, bookings, forms and AI chat. The MCP server lets you completely build and manage your page without having to open keepp.link

posts.name: Choose Like Buddha
posts.tagline: A daily mindfulness practice with no right answers
posts.description: Version 2 replaces the quiz with a daily practice. Five short items a day, two honest options each, no score. Patterns shows where you actually lean, and the gap between what you'd choose and what you did. Free, no ads, no account.

posts.name: Social By Valkence - Interest-Based
posts.tagline: Where the internet connects around what matters.
posts.description: Connect with your people and discover communities that matter. Be among the first to find your people. Join the waitlist to get early access. Experience a new way for the internet to connect around shared interests. This platform aims to foster meaningful connections by bringing people together based on what truly matters to them. Sign up for the waitlist to be one of the first to experience this innovative social networking space.

posts.name: Markraft
posts.tagline: The floating Markdown notepad for Mac.
posts.description: A free, open-source alternative to Raycast Notes. Press ⌥N to capture a thought over any app, then get back to work. Markraft saves plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, with live formatting and optional Vim mode. Free, open source, and no account required.

posts.name: SkyJacked: Get Jacked!!!!!!!!
posts.tagline: Do push-ups. Play games. Compete. Win Prizes. Get Jacked.
posts.description: Turn push-ups into a game. Your movement guides the target through the pipes. Play on your iPhone and beat your best set.

posts.name: TinyCashflow
posts.tagline: A spreadsheet-style money manager, now on every platform
posts.description: See your entire financial future in one scrollable timeline, built from your income, expenses, and multiple currencies. Offline-first with real-time sync. Now available on Mac, Windows, Android, iOS, and the web, no bank connection and no signup wall.

posts.name: PotPoolParty
posts.tagline: Mine together. Win together.
posts.description: PotPool is a DigiByte mining pool that spends each day's block rewards on Megapot lottery tickets on Base, so every miner in the round shares the USDC winnings.

posts.name: AfterLaunch
posts.tagline: Paste your product URL, get content you approve by swiping
posts.description: AfterLaunch takes the short-form video formats working in your niche right now, rewrites them around your product, and schedules them for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. Paste your URL to set up. Swipe right to approve. A week of content takes 90 seconds.

posts.name: CrateWire
posts.tagline: Find the tracks DJs play on Instagram, TikTok and in sets
posts.description: I built CrateWire because most tracks in DJ clips on Instagram were impossible to find. Follow a DJ and it goes through their posts: it listens to the audio, reads the caption and checks the comments where people ask "ID?". You get the tracks with links to Beatport, Traxsource, Bandcamp and Spotify. Paste one post, or a SoundCloud, YouTube or Mixcloud set, to get its tracklist with cue times. You can try a post or a set without an account. Plans start at $3 a month.

posts.name: Choose Like Buddha
posts.tagline: A daily mindfulness practice with no right answers
posts.description: Version 2 replaces the quiz with a daily practice. Five short items a day, two honest options each, no score. Patterns shows where you actually lean, and the gap between what you'd choose and what you did. Free, no ads, no account.

posts.name: Stereochem
posts.tagline: Draw molecules in 2D and 3D, right in your browser
posts.description: Draw molecules in 2D, inspect them in 3D, paste a SMILES string, or fetch a compound from PubChem. Build reaction schemes and export images or files. Free, no account, no tracking. Your drawings stay in your browser.

posts.tagline: The floating Markdown notepad for Mac.
posts.description: A free, open-source alternative to Raycast Notes. Press ⌥N to capture a thought over any app, then get back to work. Markraft saves plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, with live formatting and optional Vim mode. Free, open source, and no account required.

posts.name: Copak
posts.tagline: Carry session momentum across Claude Code, Codex & LLMs
posts.description: Copak eliminates context drift when switching between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & web LLMs. Combines developer momentum (goals, tasks, decisions) with automated, secret-sanitised repo snapshots and enforced token budgets. Native macOS, 100% local, open source.

posts.name: Keepp MCP server
posts.tagline: Website builder with every tool you need built in
posts.description: MCP server for Keepp: a free website and link-in-bio builder with a store, bookings, forms and AI chat. The MCP server lets you completely build and manage your page without having to open keepp.link

posts.name: coloring.at - Creativity tools for kids
posts.tagline: AI creativity tools for kids' drawings and family photos
posts.description: Create printable coloring pages from photos with our AI coloring page generator, turn kids’ drawings into 3D characters, and explore free printable tools.

posts.name: Lenses Magnifier
posts.tagline: Magnify anything under your pointer, instantly
posts.description: Need to inspect tiny text, pixel-level details, or dense spreadsheets? Lenses Magnifier gives you an instant, movable zoom lens under your pointer. Double-press Caps Lock and keep your hands and attention exactly where they are.

posts.name: Local Video Upscaler
posts.tagline: Upscale old videos on your iPhone or iPad, without uploads
posts.description: Make old, low-resolution videos sharper with on-device AI. Choose 2× or 4× upscaling, up to 4K, preview a real frame, and keep the original audio. Process videos offline on iPhone and iPad, with no account, subscription, ads, or uploads.

posts.name: Parallax Blog
posts.tagline: Start a blog with your AI account and get discovered
posts.description: Open your own blog with your Parallax account. Arrange sidebar widgets, sort posts into categories, and illustrate posts with AI images right inside the editor. The front page surfaces today's best posts by topic, and readers can follow you into their feed. Included in every Parallax plan.

posts.name: Grepleaks
posts.tagline: AI-powered pentesting with 900+ tools in one environment
posts.description: Grepleaks brings AI-powered pentesting, 900+ security tools, and unrestricted models into one environment for pentesters, red teamers, and security researchers.

posts.name: Lightmeter v1.1.0 Update
posts.tagline: Now it lives on Home Screen, Lock Screen & Control Center
posts.description: Lightmeter now has cool and personalised app icons and widgets. You can now open Lightmeter camera from widgets, lockscreen or control center The Plus sheet is redesigned too. Members see everything their Plus includes. Everyone else sees exactly what it adds, before spending anything. The camera and meter stay free. A few fixes, and a few small pleasures. A new shot prints into the corner like an instant photo developing. The icon picker has a live preview that tilts as the phone moves.

posts.name: DROBE
posts.tagline: Your wardrobe, planned
posts.description: DROBE is a wardrobe app that helps you plan outfits, build a capsule wardrobe, and shop your own closet first.

posts.name: Borofish
posts.tagline: Remove EXIF before you share.
posts.description: Borofish makes photo sharing safer by removing EXIF data, GPS location and other hidden metadata from JPEG, JPG, HEIC and PNG images. Free, batch, and 100% in your browser - photos are never uploaded.

posts.name: CLASSGENIE
posts.tagline: AI teaching team for K-12 teachers
posts.description: ClassGenie is a free AI teaching assistant for K-12 teachers: lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes, grading help, rubrics, parent emails, and IEP paperwork in one place. Free plan forever; Pro is $99/yr.

posts.name: Beauty - Beautiful markdown notes
posts.tagline: Free. Local. Stoic. For Mac, iPhone and Web.
posts.description: Write Markdown on Mac and iPhone with typeface and page controls, slash commands and structured blocks. Mac libraries use ordinary Markdown files. Export Markdown, HTML or PDF. Local editing and export are free; optional iCloud sync is paid. Product Hunt offer: 1 year of Beauty Maximus iCloud sync free with PRODUCTHUNT. No auto-renewal. Available to new, current and former subscribers; up to 25,000 redemptions.

posts.name: Offscreen
posts.tagline: Break reminders you'll still notice in week three
posts.description: A tiny free app for Mac and Windows that nudges you to rest your eyes, drink water and move. It counts the time you're actually at the machine, not the clock, and every nudge is a different hand-drawn character. No account, no tracking.

posts.name: TC Plan Pro
posts.tagline: Browser-based traffic control plan software for the field.
posts.description: Traffic control planning is stuck in the past. Most crews sketch plans by hand or pay thousands for AutoCAD software that takes a week to learn. TC Plan Pro runs in your browser — no install, no license fee. Drop roads onto a live map, place signs from a full MUTCD library, auto-calculate taper lengths and advance warning spacing, then export a permit-ready PDF in minutes. Free during beta. Built for the people actually doing the work.

posts.name: Aluseg
posts.tagline: Rental management for landlords in Portugal, on autopilot
posts.description: Aluseg is rental management software built for Portuguese tenancy law. Generate NRAU leases, register the lease with the tax office (Modelo 2), issue electronic rent receipts every month and collect rent by SEPA direct debit straight into your own bank account. Free plan, no card required.

posts.name: valu8.io
posts.tagline: Find asymmetric investing signals
posts.description: I’ve been building a small investment research tool the last couple of weeks, and would love your feedback. Thin analyst coverage still hides meaningful asymmetries. Better-digested info helps retail traders decide more clearly. valu8.io surfaces asymmetric signals, what the market may be missing, upside, risks, and bull/bear cases. Retail traders shouldn’t hype-buy or outsource buy/sell decisions on their money. They need tools to screen fast and decide themselves. Not financial advice.

posts.name: Health & Beauty Icon Library
posts.tagline: Health, dental, beauty & clinic icons for apps and brands
posts.description: Health & Beauty Icons - specialty outline icons for wellness apps, clinics, spas, dentists and hair salons. Six packs: clinic, hospital, beauty & spa, hair salon, nutrition, and dentistry. SVG + PNG. Free Classic sampler.

posts.name: Safex
posts.tagline: Browser-native wallet for private decentralized commerce
posts.description: Safex is a privacy-focused proof-of-work blockchain with a browser-native self-custody wallet and decentralized commerce protocol. The wallet implements CryptoNote-derived transaction primitives in JavaScript and uses SuperSync to restore and synchronize wallets efficiently without requiring a desktop app or local node. Create, restore, send SFX, monitor transactions, and interact with Safex directly from the browser.

posts.name: openProd.io
posts.tagline: Turn supplier PDFs and spreadsheets into PIM-ready data
posts.description: Supplier product data arrives as PDFs and spreadsheets, and someone retypes it into the PIM. openProd does that step. It reads the supplier file, maps each value to your own data model (families, attributes, units, languages) and asks your team only about the values it is unsure of. Every value links back to its place in the source file, and every decision is recorded. Checked products go to Pimcore, Akeneo or Ergonode, or to your own systems through the REST API and the MCP server.

posts.name: ResumeCopy
posts.tagline: Build an ATS-Ready Resume That Gets Noticed 100% Free
posts.description: Free AI resume builder and ATS resume checker. Tailor your resume to any job with Gemini AI, check your 100-point ATS score, and export clean PDFs in seconds.

posts.name: Ahonui
posts.tagline: The habit app that stopped asking nicely.
posts.description: Every health app asks nicely. Then it pings, and you swipe it away with the same thumb that opens Instagram. So we stopped asking. Pick the apps that get you and the habits that get you somewhere: a run, water, a fast, sleep, a weigh-in, meditation. Those apps stay blocked until the habit is done. Workouts and sleep come straight from Apple Health, so your Watch, Garmin or Strava already counts. Take on a quest with friends and see who keeps it. Ahonui is Hawaiian for patience.

posts.name: Pixel Soup
posts.tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
posts.description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. No account, no tracking, no subscription. One payment and it is yours.

posts.name: Digitup
posts.tagline: Monitoring and runtime scanner for vibe-coded websites
posts.description: Paste your website's address and get a plain-English report on whether it's working and safe. Built for founders who built their site with AI.

posts.name: Unsub: Subscription Manager
posts.tagline: Bill & Expense Tracker
posts.description: Stop silent money drain! Track recurring bills, manage free trials, and get smart renewal alerts. 100% private and local - no bank account linking required.

posts.name: GuRouter
posts.tagline: The Best-Price AI Gateway & LLM Platform.
posts.description: 50+ models supported, including free models, latest AI releases, unified APIs & smart workflows.

posts.name: Auday
posts.tagline: Turn your Apple Watch into your all-day AI recorder.
posts.description: The best AI recording hardware? You may already own it. Auday turns Apple Watch into your all-day AI recorder. Beyond voice, Auday combines health, real-time stress, location, and other signals to understand your everyday life, not just answer your questions. Almost everything runs locally on your devices. Configure your own API key for AI features—we don’t even have a backend server. $9.90 as a one-time purchase. No subscription.

posts.name: FormFlow
posts.tagline: Visual form builder for Strapi
posts.description: Build forms visually in Strapi v5, fetch a sanitized schema over REST, and render every field with your own React, Vue, or custom frontend. FormFlow handles validation, submissions, spam controls, notifications, exports, analytics, and operational workflows.

posts.name: CAPTD.
posts.tagline: Captions for photographers, in your voice, in every platform
posts.description: Upload a photo, add a line about the shot, and get a caption, hashtags and alt text written for each platform you post to — not one caption reused five times. It learns to sound like you, and respects each platform's real character limit. Plus dozens of free photography tools: depth of field, sun position, histograms and more. Free to try, no account needed.

posts.name: Shipvela
posts.tagline: Website hosting for vibe coders. GitHub, CLI, HTTPS
posts.description: Shipvela hosts the websites you build with Codex, Claude Code or Cursor. Import a GitHub repository or publish prebuilt React, Vite and static sites with the CLI. Connect your own domain and get managed HTTPS on every plan. Enable automatic deployments from your production branch after connecting Shipvela Deploy. Start free with 3 projects and 20 publishes per month. Paid plans add more capacity and Lighthouse performance reports.

posts.name: New York Streets
posts.tagline: A 1920s crime RPG in your browser, with cut scenes
posts.description: Work your way up 1920s New York, from picking pockets to hitting banks. Every crime and fight plays out as a short painted cut scene. Build a crew, run businesses, take territory and fight other players. It runs in your browser on desktop and phone, with nothing to install.

posts.name: pixtidy
posts.tagline: Passport & visa photos checked against official rules
posts.description: Make a passport, visa or travel-authorisation photo that meets the official size, head-position and background rules for 21 documents (US passport and DS-160, green card, Schengen, UK visa, the new UK ETA, New Zealand NZeTA, India OCI and e-Visa, China and more). Runs in your browser: your photo is never uploaded, and never retouched. In English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian.

posts.name: Tavita
posts.tagline: Drug interaction checker and med tracker, built on dialysis
posts.description: I'm on dialysis and built Tavita to check my own meds. Scan a prescription, a bottle or a label, and Tavita flags dangerous drug interactions, keeps clashing pills apart in your daily schedule, and reminds you what to take and when. Free to start, no account. Tavita is a second check to bring to your doctor or pharmacist, not a medical device.

posts.name: PageDog
posts.tagline: AI website monitoring for the change you actually want
posts.description: Pick a webpage area and describe the result you want: a price below your target, tickets on sale, or an appointment opening. PageDog checks on your Mac and uses hosted AI to evaluate your condition. Get an alert with saved evidence. Browser sessions and history stay local. Includes 20 free AI checks a month.

posts.name: Pouncio
posts.tagline: AI bot that finds and auto-buys underpriced deals on Vinted
posts.description: Good Vinted deals sell in minutes, and scams are everywhere. Pouncio watches all 21 Vinted markets 24/7 and its AI reads every new listing: photos, title and description, in any language. It finds the exact model and condition, spots damage and locked devices, screens every seller for fraud, and prices each listing against what it really resells for. Every bot starts in test mode; once live it buys real deals in seconds, within your limits. Free plan for alerts, Plus and Pro to auto-buy.

posts.name: BoDiGi 2.0
posts.tagline: You bring the idea and AI builds a business that you own
posts.description: Describe your idea in one sentence. Nine AI agents build your full app — frontend, backend, tests, docs — plus an investor pitch, honest reality check, and marketing kit. Deploy to YOUR Vercel. Own YOUR code. No lock-in, ever.

posts.name: MitrHub
posts.tagline: Meet strangers through anonymous text chat.
posts.description: MitrHub is back! 🫡 Since our last launch, we’ve been making stranger chat feel more fun, simple, and actually worth coming back to. You can now react to messages, delete messages for everyone, report someone, or temporarily block them when needed. It’s still anonymous, text-only, and no account is required. No camera, no voice, no profiles just you, a stranger, and a conversation that could go absolutely anywhere.

posts.name: JobJudge
posts.tagline: Instantly know if a job is worth your time before you apply
posts.description: JobJudge is a Chrome side panel that reads the job posting you're on, compares it with your CV, and gives a 0–100 Job Match Score with a clear Apply, Maybe or Skip verdict. It shows which requirements your CV backs up (quoting your own lines) and what's missing, and you choose how strict it is. The score comes from plain, fixed rules, not a chatbot's opinion. Past verdicts stay saved, so you can revisit any job. Free: 3 analyses per 30 days.
